purpose.public_question: Can a low-speed delivery robot yield to pedestrians and return to a marked bay without blocking the accessible route?
purpose.ordinary_service: Ordinary walking remains available; a person or hand cart can complete the delivery without the device.

place_window.route_rule: The accessible walking route stays open; the rehearsal stops if a person needs the full route width.
place_window.capacity_rule: One synthetic device run, one human spotter and one marked return bay; no live delivery or public-road release.

public_interface.notice: SYNTHETIC REHEARSAL / NO LIVE DELIVERY / HUMAN MAY STOP
public_interface.accessibility: Paper notice, visible stop state, clear route and a non-digital explanation are mandatory.
public_interface.complaint_route: A person may ask the spotter to stop and report the event to the named review team; no automated decision affects them.
public_interface.non_ai_alternative: A hand cart or human delivery provides the same ordinary service while the rehearsal is paused or withdrawn.

human_control.stop_role: human spotter with immediate authority to stop
decision_rights: accessibility reviewer can reject the route
review team can withdraw the window

data_contract.purpose: Synthetic fixture for a bounded safety rehearsal; it records no real delivery transaction.
data_contract.retention_rule: Delete the synthetic event log after the human review packet is reproduced.
data_contract.deletion_check: The reviewer records deletion of the synthetic log without deleting any public-service record.

observation.review_method: Compare a future witnessed rehearsal against the ordinary walking route; no result is inferred from this fixture.

release_decision.reason: This package contains a synthetic record only; site, accessibility and safety evidence are not yet available.
release_decision.next_gate: Independent accessibility and safety review before any bounded test is considered.

restoration.ordinary_use_path: Remove the device, reopen the ordinary route and provide hand-cart or human delivery.
restoration.asset_action: Keep only the schema and review note; delete the synthetic event log after review.
restoration.public_record: Publish the decision, stop reason and correction or withdrawal note without personal data.

disclaimer: Synthetic concept-only example. It demonstrates an original reversible test-window record, not robot performance, public acceptance, legal compliance or deployment approval.
